{{Quote|This is Dominus. Welcome to the middle of nowhere.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]|<ref name="SW1:SoY" />}}
'''Dominus III''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Dominus sector/Legends|Dominus sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. When seen from [[Realspace/Legends|space]], the planet had a [[Color/Legends|blue]] halo, and one could distinguish [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] and landmasses.

==History==
Following their victory at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] considered establishing their new permanent base on Dominus III. Two [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the battle, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] traveled to Dominus III, and they were [[Mission to Dominus III|ambushed]] by an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] accompanied by a group of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] and [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]]. After a short battle, Leia Organa and a TIE interceptor were both shot down and forced to crash-land on the surface of Dominus III. After the Princess [[Death/Legends|killed]] the [[Unidentified TIE/IN Interceptor pilot|TIE pilot]], she was reunited with Skywalker and Antilles, and the three Rebels made their way to the [[Redemption/Legends|''Redemption'']], the temporary base of the Alliance.<ref name="SW1:SoY" />
